head: feature/task/T-053
title: F-FND-005 Limits Registry (T-005): plan limit resolution with flag overrides + 30 s TTL caches
body:
## Summary

Closes milestone **T-005 / F-FND-005** — limits registry: every caller resolves a plan's frozen Part-2 seed values, optionally overridden per-field by `limits.<plan>.<field>` feature flags.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-053-1 exact seeds (free/pro/business × 9 fields) | T-053-04/05 — Part-2 constants asserted verbatim per plan |
| AC-053-2 exactly-one-field override, cross-plan isolation | T-053-06 — field-by-field assertions incl. all other plans unchanged |
| AC-053-3 30 s TTL (both caches) | T-053-03/06 — fake-clock younger/expired tests, same-instance + failure-not-cached proofs |
| AC-053-4 unknown plan → typed PLAN_UNKNOWN | T-053-02 — `PlanUnknownException` with `.PlanCode` at port contract and EF adapter |

EC-053-1 (unknown/foreign flag segments ignored), EC-053-3 (DB down propagates, no silent fallback) covered by the resolution + cache tests. FR-053-6: guest = caller passes `GuestPlanCode="free"`, no account lookup.

## Changes

**New code:**
- `src/wa.domain/LimitsRecord.cs` — BCL-only POCO, camelCase `[JsonPropertyName]` keys 1:1 with seeded `LimitsJson`
- `src/wa.application/Ports/LimitsStores.cs` — `IPlansStore` / `IFlagsStore` + `PlanUnknownException`
- `src/wa.infrastructure/Persistence/LimitsStores.cs` — EF adapters (indexed lookup on `Plan.Code`, unfiltered flag rows)
- `src/wa.application/Limits/Caches.cs` — `PlansCache` + `FlagsCache` (TTL via `Wa:Flags:TtlSeconds`, injectable clock)
- `src/wa.application/Limits/LimitsProvider.cs` — `Resolve(planCode)`: deserialize fresh record, apply flag overrides

**New tests:** 13 xUnit (`LimitsProviderTests` 6 + `CachesTests` 7), fakes + fake clock only (no Testcontainers per T-053 docs).

**Docs:** milestone table + all six task exit checkboxes flipped ☐→☑.

## Gate

Build 0 errors; `wa.application.unit` **18/18 passing**; domain.unit 1/1; api.integration 4/4 (Docker).
